faq.question: Do I need my old employer's approval to transfer PF?
faq.answer: Usually not. Since January 2025, claims go directly to EPFO when your UAN was issued from October 2017 onwards and is Aadhaar-linked, or when an older UAN is Aadhaar-linked and your name, date of birth and gender match. Other cases still need an employer to attest.

faq.question: How long does an EPF transfer take?
faq.answer: There's no fixed time. Since April 2025, the balance is credited as soon as the old EPF office approves the claim, but approval itself can take days or weeks, and EPFO warned of extra checks after its July 2026 portal upgrade.

faq.question: Should I transfer or withdraw my old PF?
faq.answer: Transfer, unless you genuinely need the money. Withdrawing before five years of continuous service makes much of it taxable with 10% TDS above ₹50,000, while transferring keeps your service continuous and the balance earning interest.

faq.question: Can I transfer more than one old PF account at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Enter your UAN on the transfer form, tap Get Details, and select every account listed as due for transfer before submitting with the OTP.

faq.question: What if my old company has closed?
faq.answer: The claim can be attested by your current employer if one is needed. If your UAN is from October 2017 or later and Aadhaar-linked, no employer is involved at all.
